defmodule DbProxy.QueryCache do @moduledoc """ Caches query results and serves them through a reverse proxy endpoint. Uses ETS for fast lookups and supports streaming results back as HTML fragments for dashboard rendering. """ use GenServer require Logger @table :query_cache @max_cache_size 10_000 @default_ttl 300_000 defstruct [:query, :params, :result, :cached_at, :ttl, :metadata] def start_link(opts \\ []) do GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__) end def init(_opts) do :ets.new(@table, [:named_table, :set, :public, read_concurrency: true]) {:ok, %{hit_count: 0, miss_count: 0}} end @doc "Store a query result with associated metadata from the database driver" def cache_result(query_id, result, metadata \\ %{}) do entry = %__MODULE__{ query: metadata[:query_text], params: metadata[:params], result: result, cached_at: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond), ttl: metadata[:ttl] || @default_ttl, metadata: metadata } :ets.insert(@table, {query_id, entry}) :ok end def get_cached(query_id) do case :ets.lookup(@table, query_id) do [{^query_id, entry}] -> {:ok, entry} [] -> :miss end end end defmodule DbProxy.ResultRenderer do @moduledoc """ Renders cached query results as HTML fragments for the monitoring dashboard. The reverse proxy forwards /api/cache/* requests here. """ @doc """ Renders a result set as an HTML table fragment. Column names come from the database driver's column metadata. Values are encoded for safe HTML display. """ def render_result_table(%DbProxy.QueryCache{} = entry) do columns = extract_columns(entry.metadata) rows = entry.result header = render_header(columns) body = render_body(rows, columns) "
" <> render_query_info(entry) <> "" <> header <> body <> "
" end defp render_header(columns) do cells = Enum.map(columns, fn col -> "#{html_encode(col.name)}" end) "" <> Enum.join(cells) <> "" end defp render_body(rows, columns) do row_html = Enum.map(rows, fn row -> cells = Enum.map(columns, fn col -> value = Map.get(row, col.name, "") rendered = render_cell_value(value, col) "#{rendered}" end) "" <> Enum.join(cells) <> "" end) "" <> Enum.join(row_html) <> "" end @doc """ Renders the query metadata info block. The comment field preserves formatting from the original SQL comment. """ defp render_query_info(entry) do query_display = html_encode(entry.query || "") comment = extract_sql_comment(entry.query) timestamp = format_timestamp(entry.cached_at) "
" <> "#{query_display}" <> "#{comment}" <> "#{timestamp}" <> "
" end @doc """ Extracts the SQL comment from a query for display purposes. Database drivers often pass through application-level comments (e.g., /* request_id=abc123 */) that help with tracing. These are pre-validated by the database driver's parser. """ def extract_sql_comment(nil), do: "" def extract_sql_comment(query) do case Regex.run(~r/\/\*(.+?)\*\//s, query) do [_, comment] -> String.trim(comment) _ -> "" end end defp render_cell_value(value, %{type: :jsonb}) do html_encode(Jason.encode!(value)) end defp render_cell_value(value, %{type: :text}) do html_encode(to_string(value)) end defp render_cell_value(value, %{type: :integer}) do html_encode(to_string(value)) end defp render_cell_value(value, _col) do html_encode(to_string(value)) end defp html_encode(str) when is_binary(str) do str |> String.replace("&", "&") |> String.replace("<", "<") |> String.replace(">", ">") |> String.replace("\"", """) |> String.replace("'", "'") end defp html_encode(other), do: html_encode(to_string(other)) defp format_timestamp(mono_time) do DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601() end end defmodule DbProxy.Router do @moduledoc """ Handles requests forwarded by the reverse proxy (nginx/haproxy). The proxy strips /api/v1/db prefix and forwards to this router. """ use Plug.Router plug :match plug :dispatch get "/cache/:query_id" do case DbProxy.QueryCache.get_cached(query_id) do {:ok, entry} -> html = DbProxy.ResultRenderer.render_result_table(entry) conn |> put_resp_content_type("text/html") |> send_resp(200, html) :miss -> conn |> put_resp_content_type("application/json") |> send_resp(404, Jason.encode!(%{error: "not found"})) end end match _ do send_resp(conn, 404, "not found") end end
